name: porter-nodejs
description: DEPRECATED TypeScript sender. Only `porter join` is still current; use rust-sender/ for everything else.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:external && pnpm run build:standalone && pnpm run size:report
scripts.build:external: EXTERNAL_DEPS=qrcode-generator OUTPUT_FILE=dist/porter.mjs pnpm run build:rollup && chmod +x dist/porter.mjs
scripts.build:standalone: OUTPUT_FILE=dist/porter.standalone.mjs pnpm run build:rollup && chmod +x dist/porter.standalone.mjs
scripts.install:local: pnpm run build:standalone && cp dist/porter.standalone.mjs ~/.local/bin/porter && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/porter
